turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve been having limb weakness/paralysis—also numbness/tingling in my feet and significant shortness of breath or difficulty breathing, and I recently had a viral infection.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—since you’ve had viral illness followed by limb weakness with numbness/tingling and shortness of breath, I suspect a nerve-related syndrome; can you tell me when symptoms started (days since onset) and whether weakness began in your feet/hands and how fast it’s progressing?  
Doctor: Also, do you have facial weakness, trouble swallowing, blurred/double vision, or any loss of bladder/bowel control?

Yes—I have had weakness/paralysis on one side of my face, which may still be present or completely resolved.

I don’t know about trouble swallowing, blurred/double vision, or any loss of bladder/bowel control.

Doctor: Given the recent viral illness and now one-sided facial weakness plus limb weakness with tingling and breathing difficulty, I’m concerned about a post-infectious neurological cause (like Guillain-Barré spectrum) versus stroke—are your symptoms getting worse over hours-to-days or days-to-weeks, and are both legs more weak than arms?  
Doctor: Also, do you have trouble lifting your arms/standing/walking, and do you feel your breathing is weak (worse when lying flat) or is it chest tightness?

Doctor: I need a bit more to decide between Guillain‑Barré syndrome and something like stroke or spinal cord disease—can you tell me, in the last 24 hours, is your weakness clearly worsening, and are you having any trouble walking (unsteady/needs support)?  
Doctor: Also, when you try to take a deep breath or cough, do you feel weak or unable to generate force, and have you had any fever, new back pain, or loss of sensation above the waist?
I don’t know.

Doctor: I need quick specifics—please tell me: (1) are both legs weak with tingling that started in the feet, and is it moving upward? (2) did the breathing difficulty start with the weakness (or separately)?  
Doctor: While you answer, I’m going to do an exam—can you sit upright and I’ll check your strength, reflexes, and sensation, plus your ability to count to 20 in one breath.
